limitations: AK/debugAK: lowered-pitch EQ of M4; temporary substitute, replacement planned.
Tile: one source sample; pitch/gain variation only; additional samples required.
Wood/metal/tile run and all crouch: walk samples with tuned pitch/gain.
Concrete walk/run source restored. Only guarded conversation-overlap crops are rejected; ASR absence is not proof of no speech. No speech-source separation was performed.
RMS/noise-floor are dBFS diagnostics, not calibrated SPL; short-gated tails are not independent noise recordings.
